## Objective
- Build and refine a complete playable “Vapermon Survival” browser game, then adapt it for mobile touchscreen devices.

## Requirements
- 3D open-world presentation in a GTA-style survival setting.
- Lagerfeuer crafting from berry ingredients with correct recipes and cooldown timers.
- Vapermon progression: EXP, leveling, evolution at level 50 to “Vapertation,” and higher evolution stages.
- Turn-based duels with animations and improved victory point distribution.
- Mobile smartphone layout and touchscreen controls.
- No clarifying questions; reasonable assumptions allowed.

## Decisions
- Implemented as an independent HTML/CSS/JavaScript app with no build step.
- Added a dark survival/adventure visual style with HUD, inventory, quests, crafting overlay, and duel arena.
- Added responsive CSS breakpoints and a touchscreen directional pad.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the standalone game in `index.html`.
- Added open-world-style scene, trainer, pet, houses, trees, road, fire, and pot.
- Added berry inventory and crafting recipes.
- Added 20-second crafting cooldown.
- Added EXP/level progression and evolution naming thresholds.
- Added duel mode with attacks, guard, pulse, HP, log, damage, and XP rewards.
- Added mobile CSS for smaller screens.
- Added a touchscreen directional pad and movement button handlers.
- Installed Chromium for visual testing.
- Verified JavaScript syntax successfully.
- Visually opened and tested the desktop app and overlays before the mobile refinement.
- Verified the app HTTP endpoint returned `200 OK`.

### Active
- Mobile viewport and touch interaction verification.
- Browser screenshot check for the mobile layout.

### Blocked
- `playwright-cli` stopped finding Chromium in its daemon state despite the browser being installed.
- The HTTP server showed `OSError: [Errno 98] Address already in use` when another server was attempted.
- Mobile browser testing is incomplete.

## Next Move
1. Diagnose the active port 3000 process and stop or reuse the existing server.
2. Restart or reconfigure the Playwright browser daemon so Chromium is found.
3. Open `http://127.0.0.1:3000/` in a smartphone viewport.
4. Capture `screenshots/mobile.jpg` and inspect the result.
5. Test the directional pad, Lagerfeuer button, inventory, and duel actions with touchscreen input.
6. Fix any mobile overflow or overlapping controls discovered during testing.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/Vapermon-Survival-Game/Vapermon-Survival-Game/index.html`: Main app containing scene, mobile CSS, crafting, progression, duel logic, and touch controls.
- `/home/runner/work/Vapermon-Survival-Game/Vapermon-Survival-Game/screenshots/vapermon.jpg`: Existing desktop viewport screenshot.
